text:
maria: Quick idea  "Midday High-Five" week: 5 days of short recognition pop-ups at lunch (11:45am-12:15pm) across offices + live stream. Purpose: low-effort moments to collect shoutouts for the quarterly spotlight. Looking for volunteers to run 3 campus stations and one person to own the RSVP form + catering.

jonah: love this. i can run the SF lobby station Tue/Thu. happy to digitize sticky notes into the monthly reel.

paula: i can cover the NY office Wed. will need a small poster and a QR code that links to a 1-line submission form.

viv: i'll prep a 3-bullet template for people to use: 1) what happened, 2) impact, 3) one-sentence outcome. will share in the doc.

rebecca: logistics: headcount? food? budget? i can handle boxed snacks if we keep to $120 per location. finance-bot, any limits?

finance-bot: Reminder: ad-hoc pop-up catering limit is $200 per location. Submit receipts to Concur under code REC-HF. Small promo materials ok under $100 without PO.

mike: i can pick up snacks for SF on Tue at 11:30am if needed. will submit expense.

maria: Awesome. Volunteers summary: SF (jonah+mike pickup), NY (paula), London (looking for volunteer)  who can cover London Fri? Also need form owner (rebecca?) and comms post (viv).

paula: i can ask the London office manager if anyone wants to host Fri. happy to help coordinate remotely if needed.

rebecca: i'll own the RSVP/form and add a dietary field + a short consent checkbox for sharing highlights. will publish by EOD Friday.

viv: I'll draft the Slack blurb and a mini-poster (QR + time + "Bring one 1-line story"). Will post draft in #general tomorrow.

maria: small ask: can someone add a 1-paragraph FAQ about how shoutouts feed into spot awards (without promising awards)? managers sometimes confuse the two.

jonah: i can draft a sentence: "Shoutouts are informal and help populate the monthly highlight reel; formal spot awards require a nomination and review per People Ops guidelines." put in the FAQ doc.

maria: perfect. last checklist: volunteers, form (rebecca), draft poster (viv), pickup (mike), digitizer (jonah). If we get >30 in-person RSVPs for any location we'll stream only seating. Everyone please add availability to the form by COB Thurs. Thanks :sparkles:
